acceptanceCriteria: When both files are .go, a pair relation is admitted only within the same directory.
The 5-PR replay shows zero cross-directory Go pair rows, and gold recall on the TCP frozen set does not regress.
A maintained test covers a same-stem cross-directory Go pair being refused and a same-directory pair being kept.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Source: read-only rc.3 accuracy survey 2026-10-06 (origin/main 3dc863bd, installed rc.2 build 360) replaying merged PRs 571, 614, 594, 557, 610 at their merge-base. Harness and outputs: /private/tmp/claude-501/td-survey (local, not retained in the repository). pairRelation (internal/contextindex/taskcontext.go:538-552) pairs any matching file stem anywhere in the tree at medium confidence. 10 of 100 packet rows in the replay were wrong pairs, for example internal/trace/store_test.go paired with internal/tasks/store/store.go. A Go _test.go must share its package directory with the code it tests. Related: V1-0431, V1-0859, decision 0026. Being addressed in the rc.3 orientation lane (branch claude/rc3-orientation-v1-0859) as a separate commit.

completion.reason: Landed in beamfall/corvint PR #639 (rc3 batch 2), merge 76f7f2ac. TCP-V0-004 amended: when both files are .go a pair relation is admitted only with a same-directory Go counterpart (pairRelation/isGoPath in internal/contextindex). Maintained tests TestPairRelationGoCounterpartsShareTheDirectory and TestTaskContextCounterpartElsewhereIsAMediumPairRow cover a same-stem cross-directory Go pair being refused and a same-directory pair being kept; internal/contextindex passed locally and all 14 hosted CI checks passed. 5-PR replay: cross-tree pair rows 10 -> 1, and the remaining row is JS<->JS, so zero cross-directory Go pairs. Gold recall did not regress: TCP frozen cases 25 carried/15 misses -> 29/10; held-out recall 18/59, equal to main. Evidence hashes: build log docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0859-orientation-misses.md and spec docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md at merge 76f7f2ac. Limit: no independent held-out repository (owner question under V1-0859).

title: context --task: Go pair relation links a _test.go to a same-stem file in another directory
